description: This file defines the AzureAISearchIndexProfileDisplayDriver class, which manages the display and update logic for Azure AI search index profiles within OrchardCore. It includes methods for editing index profiles and handling updates asynchronously.

classes.name: AzureAISearchIndexProfileDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver class for managing Azure AI search index profile views and updates within OrchardCore.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Prepares the display for editing an IndexProfile, initializing view models for index profile settings and query settings.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Handles asynchronous updates to the IndexProfile based on user input, updating metadata and query settings accordingly.
